cockpit.open_detail_tooltip: Open detailed settings on the side ({section})
cockpit.auto_acdc_tooltip: Toggle automatic Plugged In / Battery profile switching
board.experimental_desc: This laptop model is not yet in the verified list. Hardware changes are paused for your safety until you review diagnostics and approve below.
board.probe_summary: System check: {ok} / {total} hardware probes responded normally.
monitor.title: System Monitor & Graphs
monitor.ec_note: CPU, GPU, memory, and power update at your chosen interval; fans and battery update once per second.
monitor.cpu_temp_pawnio_hint: Reading exact CPU core temperature requires the signed temperature driver (no OMEN Gaming Hub needed). Showing chassis temperature in the meantime.
monitor.thermal_guard_active: OVERHEAT PROTECTION: Emergency Max Fan Active
monitor.no_throttle_tooltip: GPU is running cleanly without thermal or power throttling.
monitor.throttle_active_tooltip: GPU is currently reducing clock speed due to: {reason}.
monitor.gpu_pstate_tooltip: Current graphics power state (P0 = full performance, P8 = idle power saving).
monitor.gpu_sleeping_tooltip: Dedicated GPU is asleep to save battery. Polling is paused so it stays asleep.
auto_profile.dim_keyboard_on_battery: Turn off keyboard lighting on battery
fan.link_cpu_gpu_desc: When enabled, both fans follow the CPU speed/curve. Disable to tune CPU and GPU fans independently.
fan.gpu_linked_notice: GPU fan is currently synced to CPU fan. Turn off the link toggle above to set an independent GPU fan speed or curve.
fan.hysteresis_desc: Prevents fans from constantly ramping up and down: fan speed drops only after temperature falls by this amount below its peak.
fan.keep_alive_desc: Periodically refreshes your custom fan speed so the laptop does not reset fans to Auto after 2 minutes.
fan.no_cpu_sensor_notice: Direct CPU core sensor not installed: fan curve runs safely using chassis/power estimates and {temp}°C overheat protection.
fan.curve_drag_hint: Drag the points on the graph to adjust temperature and fan speed.
fan.conflict_service_warning: Another HP OMEN or fan control app is running in the background and may override fan or power settings.
fan.guard_desc: Automatically switches to Max Fan to protect hardware if the processor stays above the threshold continuously for this duration.
fan.curve_import_placeholder: Paste curve share code (OMVIXCURVE1|...) or JSON
fan.curve_imported: Fan curve imported and applied safely.
battery.preset_desktop_desc: Stop 60% / Start 55% — Best when mostly plugged in
battery.preset_balanced_desc: Stop 80% / Start 75% — Ideal daily battery protection
battery.preset_full_desc: Removes the limit and charges to 100%
battery.no_custom_profiles: No custom battery profiles saved yet.
battery.travel_mode_desc: Allows charging to 100% once, then automatically returns to your charge limit when full or unplugged.
battery.one_time_active: One-time 100% charge active — will revert when full or unplugged.
battery.hold_when_shutdown: Keep charge limit when powered off or sleeping (Recommended)
battery.hold_when_shutdown_desc: Keeps your battery from charging past the limit even while powered off. When turned off, normal 100% charging resumes on exit.
battery.service_desc: Optional lightweight Windows service that protects your battery limit even when the app window is closed and during sleep/shutdown.
battery.service_uninstall_confirm_desc: Removes the background service, restores normal 100% charging, and deletes C:\Program Files\OmvixHub & C:\ProgramData\OmvixHub.
battery.service_active_sync_note: Background service is active: charge limits stay synced automatically.
battery.service_recommended_note: Tip: Install the background service below so your charge limit holds reliably across sleep and shutdown.
battery.recovery_desc: To immediately restore normal 100% charging without opening the app, run this command as Administrator:
battery.conflict_service_warning: External `hp-charge-limit-rs` service is running. Automatic writes are paused to avoid conflicts.
lighting.no_custom_profiles: No custom lighting profiles yet. Pick colors and brightness, then save.
gpu.sleeping_desc: Dedicated GPU is currently powered down to save battery. It wakes automatically when a game or 3D app launches.
gpu.mux_desc: Hybrid mode preserves battery life; Discrete GPU lowers display latency for gaming. Changing this mode requires a restart.
gpu.reboot_required: A system restart is required to apply graphics mode changes.
gpu.bitlocker_warning: Warning: Switching to Discrete GPU mode may ask for a BitLocker recovery key on next boot, change external display routing, and shorten battery life.
gpu.reboot_prompt: New graphics mode saved. Restart Windows to apply:
tuning.cpu_boost_desc: Controls how aggressively the processor boosts clock speeds under load. Choose Off or Enabled for quieter operation.
tuning.power_limits_desc: Lower sustained (PL1) or short boost (PL2) limits to reduce heat and fan noise under sustained load.
tuning.admin_required_warning: Administrator permission is required to apply hardware changes.
tuning.power_limit_unknown_board: Processor power limits are disabled on unverified laptops for safety.
hotkeys.custom_command_hint: Only .exe or .lnk files are allowed; launched with standard user permissions.
hotkeys.capture_hint: Click "Record Shortcut" and press your desired combination (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+O).
conflicts.title: Conflicting Background Apps
conflicts.none_detected: No conflicting HP or charge-limit background services detected.
conflicts.detected_summary: Detected {count} active background service(s) that may override fan, power, or battery settings. Click for details.
logs.title: Activity Logs
diagnostics.title: System & Hardware Diagnostics
settings.hide_on_focus_loss: Auto-hide to tray when clicking outside
settings.autostart_admin_note: Copies the app into Program Files and starts automatically at Windows sign-in without UAC prompts.
settings.installed_copy_outdated: Installed copy is older than the running version.
settings.pawnio_desc: Installs the Microsoft-signed temperature driver so Omvix Hub can read exact CPU core temperatures without OMEN Gaming Hub.
settings.reset_desc: Restores Auto fans, Balanced mode, normal 100% battery charging, and resets all app settings to defaults.
safe_mode.banner_title: Safe Mode Active — Hardware Changes Disabled
safe_mode.reason_cli: Launched in safe mode. No hardware settings were changed.
safe_mode.reason_shift: Shift key was held at startup. Hardware changes were skipped.
safe_mode.reason_crash_loop: Automatic protection: unexpected exits were detected on recent launches. Hardware writes are paused for safety.
config.corrupt_backup_notice: Unreadable settings file was backed up to {path} and defaults were loaded ({error}).
config.corrupt_rename_failed: Failed reading settings file ({error}); backup could not be created, original left intact.
wizard.title: Omvix Hub Setup Wizard
wizard.step1_desc: Omvix Hub identifies your laptop model and verifies fan, performance, and battery control support.
wizard.step2_desc: Optional: start Omvix Hub automatically in the background at sign-in without UAC prompts.
wizard.step3_desc: Install the Microsoft-signed temperature driver to read exact CPU core temperatures.
wizard.step3_optional_note: Optional — fan curves and safety guards still work safely via chassis & GPU sensors, and you can install this later in Settings.
wizard.step4_desc: Protect battery health by setting a maximum charge limit (for example, 80%).
wizard.step4_hold_warning: Note: Your selected charge limit stays active even when the laptop is shut down.
wizard.step5_desc: Review your choices below. You can change any setting later from the main menu.
wizard.safe_mode_tip: Tip: Hold Shift at startup anytime to open Omvix Hub in read-only Safe Mode.
profiles.app_profiles_desc: Automatically switches performance mode, fan curve, refresh rate, and CPU boost when selected apps launch, and restores your previous settings on exit.
profiles.no_running_snapshot: Click Refresh to scan open apps
profiles.invalid_exe_error: Enter a valid executable filename (e.g. game.exe).
history.title: Recent Changes (Last 10)
history.empty: No changes recorded in this session yet.
battery.health_history_empty: No battery health records logged yet. Weekly snapshots are saved automatically.
hotkeys.conflict_detail: {shortcut} is already used by Windows or another app. Pick a different shortcut:
hotkeys.conflict_toast: Shortcut conflict: {shortcut} is already used by another app.
settings.keyboard_nav_hint: Shortcuts: Ctrl+1..4 open sections, Ctrl+Tab cycles drawers, Alt+Left/Right switches subtabs, Esc closes.
updates.title: App Updates
updates.auto_check: Check for updates automatically at startup
updates.signature_policy_note: Updates are downloaded exclusively from official GitHub Releases and verified with SHA-256 checksums.
updates.blocked_by_sig_policy: Blocked for security: this release lacks a digital signature. Enable unsigned updates above only if you trust this release.
